translations.web: The Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.
translations.bsb: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
translations.kjv: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
